notes: INSIDE half of the Prismatic Refractor: three small crystals in a row with a thin light line passing through them that splits into colours, a steel hatch, power coupling and five crystals. damaged: the middle crystal cracked and dark, lines flicker; disabled: crystals split and dull. Barrel layer prismatic_refractor_barrel: a short violet barrel ending in a big faceted crystal head; fire: three shards leave the head fanning out, flashing. COMPACT (tier 1-2 parts take less room inside): this inside half is the centre of the original art between its own edge columns, re-outlined (art/_src/compact.py).
